title: Lulu's Beef & Broccoli Fried Rice
ingredients: Beef Marinade: 1 tbsp oyster, 2 tsp soy, 1 tsp baking soda, 2 tsp cornstarch
Sauce: 2 tbsp oyster, 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tbsp sugar
Sauce 2: 1 tsp sesame oil, 0.5 tsp 5-spice, 0.5 tsp pepper, 2 tbsp water
Base: 0.5 tbsp oil, 4 cups cooked jasmine rice, 4 cups broccoli florets
Aromatics: 5 cloves garlic, 2 tsp ginger, 3 spring onions
Toppings: 4 fried eggs, chilli oil, sesame seeds
steps: Combine sliced beef with oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, baking soda, cornstarch, and white pepper, then rest for fifteen minutes.
Pour boiling water over the broccoli florets, let sit for two minutes, and drain thoroughly.
Heat oil in a large pan over high heat, stir-fry the beef for two to three minutes until browned, then set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, and spring onion whites in oil for one minute, then add rice and cook until hot and toasted.
Add broccoli, sauce, and cooked beef back to the pan, toss until heated through, and stir in spring onion greens.
Serve hot topped with a fried egg, a drizzle of chilli oil, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
